content.short: Outposts gathers community updates from across web3 and delivers a personalized email digest.
content.description: Outposts pulls updates from across Web3 and delivers a personalized email digest. It uses Web3 interoperability to automatically curate content from the communities you follow, so you stay informed without chasing signals in multiple places. All your communities are gathered in one place, making it simple to monitor progress and activity. Outposts also helps you reach parts of your audience that haven’t seen your project in months, reviving engagement over email.
